claim: Comprehensive 2026 list with chef, neighbourhood, cuisine and price details for every starred restaurant in London.
quote: Sketch Lecture Room & Library — Mayfair, Modern/Experimental, £165–£225 tasting menu. Alain Ducasse at the Dorchester — Mayfair, French haute cuisine, £215–£285. Core by Clare Smyth — Notting Hill, £255–£265 tasting menu; £195–£225 a la carte.

claim: Official 2026 list of London's three-star and two-star restaurants, including the two new two-star awards.
quote: New to Two Stars: Row on 5, Bonheur by Matt Abé. Retained Two Stars: A. Wong, Alex Dilling at Hotel Café Royal, Brooklands by Claude Bosi, Da Terra, Dinner by Heston Blumenthal, Gymkhana, Humble Chicken, Ikoyi, Kitchen Table, Restaurant Story, The Clove Club, The Ritz Restaurant, Trivet.

claim: All existing three-starred London restaurants retained status in 2026; no new three-star awards.
quote: All the existing three-starred restaurants retained their status for 2026. New 2-Star: Row on 5 (Sommelier Award winner), Bonheur by Matt Abé.

claim: Bonheur by Matt Abé is Matt Abé's debut solo venture; Row on 5 promoted to two stars in 2026.
quote: Two restaurants achieved two-star status: Bonheur by Matt Abé (Mayfair) - Chef Matt Abé's debut solo venture; Row on 5 (Mayfair) - Jason Atherton's flagship London restaurant with former Ritz head chef Spencer Metzger leading the kitchen.

claim: Core's signature tasting menus and Notting Hill location.
quote: Modern fine dining restaurant with a strong British ethos, in an elegant, relaxed interior. 92 Kensington Park Road, Notting Hill.

claim: The Ledbury was promoted to three stars in 2024; Brett Graham is the first Australian chef and co-owner to win three stars.
quote: The restaurant regained both Michelin stars in the 2023 Michelin Guide and was promoted to three Michelin stars in the 2024 Michelin guide. Brett Graham is the first Australian chef and co-owner of a restaurant to win three stars.

claim: Michelin inspector's description of The Ledbury's cooking as quiet, ingredient-driven and balanced.
quote: Ingredients are amplified by beautifully balanced combinations and the kitchen's ability to deliver multiple layers of flavour without overcomplicating things, such as in the hay-aged pigeon with girolles, vadouvan, cherry and sauerkraut.

claim: Sketch's Lecture Room & Library is one of several spaces in the 9 Conduit Street venue; Pierre Gagnaire is chef-patron.
quote: Sketch at 9 Conduit Street in Mayfair, comprising the Lecture Room & Library, the Gallery Gastro Brasserie, the Glade restaurant and bar, and the Parlour all-day café and bar.

claim: Hélène Darroze at The Connaught menu and dining room details.
quote: The kitchen team brings outstanding technical mastery and attention to detail to the very best seasonal produce, with some accompanying flavours informed by Hélène's international travels, like the Isle of Mull lobster with tandoori spices.

claim: Restaurant Gordon Ramsay has held three Michelin stars for 25 consecutive years.
quote: The restaurant earned three Michelin stars in 2001, a distinction proudly upheld in the 2026 Michelin Guide. It has held three Michelin stars for an extraordinary 25 consecutive years.

claim: Alain Ducasse at The Dorchester has held three Michelin stars since 2010 and was re-imagined in January 2020.
quote: The restaurant has been awarded 3 Michelin stars since 2010 and was re-imagined in January 2020, offering contemporary French cuisine in a modern, bright and elegant setting.

claim: Ikoyi's tasting menu and West-African-influenced approach at 180 The Strand.
quote: Founder and chef Jeremy Chan's surprise tasting menu uses high-quality organic produce from the British Isles, married with global spices. Reservations are released on the 1st of each month at 12:00 pm (GMT).

claim: Kitchen Table is a 20-cover counter restaurant in Fitzrovia, two stars since 2018.
quote: Tucked away on Charlotte Street in Fitzrovia, a two Michelin-starred restaurant led by chef James Knappett and sommelier Sandia Chang, which invites just 20 guests per evening to witness culinary artistry up close at a horseshoe-shaped counter.

claim: Bonheur menu format and signature dishes.
quote: Guests can choose from a three-course à la carte (£165), a five-course 'Journey' menu (£195), or a seven-course 'Dream' menu (£225). Signature dishes include a reinvented 'Quiche Lorraine' using smoked ham, leeks, and Gruyère.

claim: Row on 5 is the first restaurant ever leased on Savile Row; 15-course tasting menu across three acts.
quote: Jason Atherton's flagship restaurant on Savile Row, the first restaurant ever to be leased on Savile Row in its 290-year-old history. A world-class 15-course tasting menu divided into three acts.

claim: Gymkhana opened 2013, earned its first star one year later and a second in 2024.
quote: Two-Michelin-star restaurant in Mayfair, London. Opened in 2013, the restaurant earned its first star one year later, followed by a second star in 2024.

claim: A. Wong became the first Chinese restaurant outside Asia to win two Michelin stars (Jan 2021).
quote: In January 2021, it became the first Chinese restaurant outside Asia to achieve two Michelin stars.

claim: Alex Dilling at Hotel Café Royal is a 34-seat, classically-French two-star restaurant near Piccadilly.
quote: Two Michelin-starred restaurant featuring a modern take on French gastronomic cuisine served in an elegant dining room overlooking Regent Street, with space for just 34 guests.

claim: Brooklands by Claude Bosi is a Belgravia rooftop restaurant; won two stars within four months of opening (2024).
quote: Two Michelin star rooftop restaurant at The Peninsula London with unrivalled views over Belgravia and nearby Hyde Park. Awarded two stars in the 2024 guide — first restaurant in the UK to do so in under four months since opening.

claim: The Clove Club is Isaac McHale's two-star modern British restaurant in Shoreditch Town Hall.
quote: Chef Isaac McHale's relaxed fine dining restaurant with two Michelin Stars, set in the historic rooms of the Grade II-listed Shoreditch Town Hall. Started life as Shoreditch's new kid on the block in 2013.

claim: Da Terra is Rafael Cagali's Brazilian-Italian fusion restaurant in Bethnal Green's Town Hall Hotel.
quote: Two Michelin Stars at Town Hall Hotel, 8 Patriot Square, Bethnal Green. Chef Rafael Cagali draws on his Brazilian and Italian heritage in skilfully crafted, highly original dishes. Signature reinvented version of the Brazilian 'moqueca' fish stew.

claim: Dinner by Heston's menu draws on British food history; signature 'Meat Fruit' and 'Forme of Cury'-inspired dishes.
quote: Inspired by historic British gastronomy, the menu offers a modern take on recipes that date back as far as the 13th century. Signature illusory 'Meat Fruit' provides a smooth chicken liver parfait.

claim: Dinner by Heston Blumenthal will close in January 2027 after a 6-month extension; lease with Mandarin Oriental ending.
quote: Dinner by Heston Blumenthal won't be closing until January 2027. Originally due to conclude in summer 2026, the residency has been extended by six months in response to continued demand.

claim: Humble Chicken is a 13-seat chef's-table omakase in Soho, second star awarded in 2025.
quote: Chef Angelo Sato's 2 Michelin-starred restaurant in Soho — a 13-seat chef's table experience centered around a completely open kitchen, offering a 16-course Omakase menu. Located at 54 Frith Street.

claim: Restaurant Story serves a 9-course tasting menu; second star awarded 2021.
quote: Tom Sellers' two Michelin Star flagship restaurant. First Michelin star after five months of opening in 2013, second Michelin star in 2021. Current dinner offering is a nine-course tasting menu priced at £250 per person.

claim: The Ritz Restaurant's Louis XVI-inspired dining room and executive chef John Williams MBE.
quote: The Ritz Restaurant in Mayfair: Two Michelin Star Dining. John Williams MBE joined The Ritz London as Executive Chef in 2004. The Arts de la Table four-course menu showcases the finest seasonal ingredients.

claim: The Ritz Restaurant was awarded a second Michelin star in the 2025 guide.
quote: The Ritz Restaurant was awarded a second star in the MICHELIN Guide Great Britain and Ireland 2025. 'I have waited 50 years for this moment,' commented Chef Williams.

claim: Trivet is Jonny Lake & Isa Bal's Bermondsey restaurant; à la carte rather than a forced tasting menu.
quote: Located on a peaceful street moments from London Bridge station, the debut solo project from The Fat Duck alumni Jonny Lake and Isa Bal. Jonny opts for an à la carte menu with around five or six options for starter, main and dessert.

claim: Kim Ratcharoen was appointed Chef de Cuisine at Restaurant Gordon Ramsay in 2025; £125 three-course lunch is the lowest entry point of any UK 3-star.
quote: Kim Ratcharoen was appointed Chef de Cuisine in 2025. Restaurant Gordon Ramsay recently introduced a £125 three-course lunch menu — a much lower entry point than any other three-star in the UK.

claim: Bonheur opened in November 2025 in Mayfair at 43 Upper Brook Street, occupying the former Le Gavroche space.
quote: 43 Upper Brook Street, Mayfair. Modern fine-dining restaurant designed to inspire complete contentment. Chef Matt Abé's first solo restaurant, opened in November 2025.

claim: Gymkhana's address (42 Albemarle Street) and Indian colonial-club design across two levels.
quote: 42 Albemarle Street, Mayfair. Inspired by the elite clubs of India where members of high society socialise, eat, drink, celebrate and play sport. Two floors each offer a distinctive look and feel.

claim: The Ledbury's address (127 Ledbury Road) and Brett Graham's farm-to-table programme (own deer, Jersey cows, Iberian pigs).
quote: 127 Ledbury Road, Notting Hill, London W11 2AQ. The Ledbury showcases seasonal ingredients along with their own Deer, Jersey Cows and Iberian Pigs which are reared by Chef/Owner Brett Graham.

claim: A. Wong's 'Collections of China' tasting menu in Pimlico.
quote: Andrew Wong's inspiration comes from across all the Chinese provinces; the 'Collections of China' evening menu presents his unique interpretations of regional dishes.
